body:
P2-12 SLICE 1 (the Deezer gate): PR #80 is open (not a draft), no merge by me. P2-12 is NOT built (1 of 8). Slices 2, 3, 5-8 and 4 are not started.

WHAT. Server only. (1) ONE gate to Deezer (deezer.py): 20 requests/5 s after a burst of 6, 4 in flight, a person before background work (250 ms between background requests), a rest of 30 s doubling to 10 min after 429/5xx/the quota body (HTTP 200 with an error) or 3 timeouts in 30 s, one trial request after it, ENCORE_CATALOGUE=0 opens no socket. (2) The cover finder, the artist finder and the keeper's cover use it; the B-124 and B-127 tests are unedited and pass, plus new tests that run the real look-ups through the gate. (3) catalogue.py + catalogue-cache.db (own file, not encore.db, not in the backup): unit = the outside request, single flight, TTLs 15 min/24 h/6 h/7 d, empty 5 min, stale up to 30 days only if it holds something, could-not-ask never stored. The finders do NOT use the cache. (4) Routes catalogue/search, artists/{id}, albums/{id}, genres, genres/{id}, feature "catalogue", info.catalogue; a read makes no ref or row (tested); answers saved as app/test/fixtures/server/catalogue-*.json. (5) A socket-level network guard under EVERY server test; it found two old tests fetching a real picture from YouTube's picture host.

THE PR SAYS: the finders' behaviour changes (shared budget, one refusal rests all callers, new User-Agent, fail closed, the switch); only the routes are additive.

DECISIONS (owner away; alternatives in brackets). Switch off: routes answer 404 not_found, reason catalogue_off [503: it is not an outage]. Search: artists always 8, limit applies to albums and songs [limit for all: changes what the phone gets]. Picture fields are null for Deezer's plain "picture"/"cover" (api.deezer.com redirect, tells Deezer who asked) and for the silhouette [pass through]. Releases folded by a port of the phone's normalizeForMatch, every script, empty key never merges, NOT textnorm (B-37). Finders keep their 8 s timeout, a person's request 2 s [2 s for all changes the finders]. Nothing installed = CatalogueOff, fail closed. An unknown Deezer error code is could-not-ask but does NOT rest the gate (only 429, 5xx, 403, codes 4 and 700, 3 timeouts do), so one odd query cannot stop everybody. Keeper: LookupUnavailable is one quiet line, not a stack trace per song.

LEFT. docs/31 2b, 33, 34, 19, 04 (the catalogue as a capability) move with slice 2. B-89: convention in docs/17; docs/18, migration comment and PUT saved-albums refusal still open. B-88: the check that every outside host is named in PRIVACY.md is not built; Host-settings page is P3-09. No Russian recording (only errors may be synthetic): Russian and Arabic covered at the title-folding level only. F13: artists holds the lead only. The integration job (real Navidrome) was not run; the guard lets its host through. The gate's figures (40 % of Deezer's published one) were never measured: slice 2's walk should read the real limit once.

NEXT. Slices 3 and 5 need P2-25 first (D4); slice 2 is held until b11 or your word. If errands() in api.py conflicts when #80 merges, keep both errands.
